extracted.name: Tea Cakes
extracted.description: You can make these buttery and delicious tea cake treats by using ingredients you probably have in your pantry for the perfect addition to your afternoon tea.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet.

Beat butter and sugar in a bowl until creamy. Stir in flour, vanilla extract, baking powder, and baking soda until dough is well mixed. Drop spoonfuls of dough 2-inches apart onto prepared baking sheet.
Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes.
